defects.issue: Every object-detection event post failed.
defects.root_cause: Detector returned numpy float32 boxes, which json.dumps cannot serialise.
defects.fix: Cast box coordinates to Python floats in detector.postprocess.

defects.issue: Unhandled promise rejection ('ICE timeout') when WebRTC negotiation failed early.
defects.root_cause: The ICE-connected promise was created but never awaited on the early-failure path.
defects.fix: Attach a no-op catch before signalling; fall back to HLS.

defects.issue: Genuine people could be missed (cosine 0.32 < 0.42).
defects.root_cause: Three frame embeddings were averaged; one poor frame dragged the mean below threshold.
defects.fix: Send samples individually; the API requires >= 2 samples agreeing on the same person.

defects.issue: Swapping between photos of different poses was not rejected.
defects.root_cause: Intermediate-pose evidence was computed but never enforced.
defects.fix: Require intermediate poses before each challenge step ('movement too abrupt').

defects.issue: Genuine users asked to tilt up were falsely rejected.
defects.root_cause: Neutral pitch baseline was the median over all frames, including tilted ones.
defects.fix: Baseline from the opening 'look straight' frames only.

defects.issue: Console rendered a blank page.
defects.root_cause: app.js referenced a view defined in campus.js (loaded later), aborting script execution.
defects.fix: Register campus views from campus.js; boot after DOMContentLoaded.

defects.issue: An older, observed MFA code could be replayed after a newer code had been used (within its 90 s validity).
defects.root_cause: Replay check compared only against the last code used, not the time step.
defects.fix: RFC 6238 implementation that accepts a code only if its time step is strictly later than the last accepted step.

defects.issue: CSV/Excel formula injection: a name like =HYPERLINK(...) executes when the export is opened.
defects.root_cause: User-controlled text written to CSV unescaped (CWE-1236).
defects.fix: Prefix cells beginning with = + - @ TAB CR LF with an apostrophe.

defects.issue: Unicode digits (e.g. full-width '１２３４５６') in an MFA field caused a server error.
defects.root_cause: str.isdigit() accepts Unicode digits; hmac.compare_digest raises TypeError on non-ASCII.
defects.fix: Require ASCII digits before comparison.

defects.issue: Backlit faces were scored instead of being sent back for better lighting.
defects.root_cause: Brightness was measured over the 1.5x crop, which includes the bright background.
defects.fix: Measure the detector face box against its surroundings.

defects.issue: Blurred faces were still detectable (7 of 305) and one remained matchable by the recogniser (cosine 0.44 >= 0.42).
defects.root_cause: Pixelation grid scaled up to 7 cells across, preserving coarse facial layout on larger faces.
defects.fix: Fixed 4-cell grid plus stronger smoothing: 0 of 305 re-detected; identity similarity <= 0.34.

defects.found_by: Security code review, proven with a crafted JPEG
defects.issue: Decompression bomb: a 1.2 MB JPEG made the server allocate 243 MB (x90 frames per kiosk request).
defects.root_cause: Only file size was limited; OpenCV decoded images of any declared dimension.
defects.fix: Read dimensions from the header (Pillow) and refuse oversized images before decoding.

defects.issue: Logout did not revoke the session token; a copied cookie stayed valid for up to 30 min.
defects.root_cause: Stateless JWT with cookie deletion only.
defects.fix: Logout bumps the user's session version (server-side revocation of all that user's sessions).

defects.issue: A super admin approving more than 5 items in 15 minutes was locked out.
defects.root_cause: The rate limiter counted successful MFA checks as well as failures.
defects.fix: Count failures only (5 per 15 min).

defects.issue: Only 6 possible challenge sequences: a pre-recorded attempt matched 1 time in 6.
defects.root_cause: Two distinct moves chosen from three.
defects.fix: Three moves, no immediate repeats: 12 sequences (and texture anti-spoofing on every frame).

defects.issue: The earlier anti-spoof hook would have scored faces incorrectly.
defects.root_cause: 2.7x crop, plain stretch to 128 px and softmax, unlike the model's training pipeline (1.5x square reflect-padded crop, letterbox, logit-difference threshold).
defects.fix: Faithful port of the reference runtime (antispoof.py), verified against the reference test-suite assertions.

defects.issue: An admin could reset a super admin's password and MFA and take over the approval role.
defects.root_cause: User management did not distinguish super admin targets.
defects.fix: Only super admins can create, modify, reset or delete super admin accounts; the last super admin is protected.

defects.issue: Playback showed 'no supported format' and export saved an error page.
defects.root_cause: Demo cameras were created with recording off; the UI requested non-existent footage.
defects.fix: Encrypted recorder with segment index; the UI only offers recorded ranges and reports errors in plain text.

defects.issue: Footage, database and secrets were stored inside a OneDrive-synced folder.
defects.root_cause: Data folder lived inside the project folder.
defects.fix: Data moved to %USERPROFILE%\SentinelVMS with automatic migration and secret rotation.

defects.issue: Install failed on Windows ('failed to locate pyvenv.cfg').
defects.root_cause: Microsoft Store Python redirects AppData writes into its sandbox.
defects.fix: Prefer python.org interpreters; data outside AppData; self-healing virtualenv.

defects.issue: Every install started with a predictable 'admin' account whose initial password was printed to the console, written to FIRST-LOGIN.txt and logged by Docker.
defects.root_cause: Bootstrap created a default super admin instead of letting the installer register.
defects.fix: No built-in account: a one-time 80-bit setup code (0600 file, local terminal only, rotated after 10 failures) lets the first super admin register and enrol MFA; setup closes permanently afterwards.

defects.issue: Admins created users and reset passwords by reading out a temporary password, so the admin knew another person's credentials (no non-repudiation).
defects.root_cause: Temporary-password workflow.
defects.fix: Single-use invitation and reset links (256-bit, stored as SHA-256, 24-168 h); the person chooses their own password; the old password stops working at reset.

defects.issue: An admin could promote any account to admin, or reset and disable other admins.
defects.root_cause: Only super admin targets were protected.
defects.fix: Only a super admin can invite, promote, reset, disable or delete admins and super admins; anyone may edit their own alert contacts.

defects.issue: Password policy was length-only (and absent for the bootstrap password).
defects.root_cause: No shared policy function.
defects.fix: One policy for setup, registration, reset and change: 12+ characters, not containing the username, not common, not repetitive, 3 character classes below 16 characters.

defects.issue: The live wall's site filter had no accessible name for screen readers.
defects.root_cause: Select rendered without a label.
defects.fix: aria-label added; UI-20 now checks every visible control on the main screens.

defects.issue: On a machine that had never run the app, `run.py --selftest` crashed while saving the face models.
defects.root_cause: The models folder was only created by the normal start-up path, not by the model download itself.
defects.fix: The download creates its own folder.
defects.verified_by: GitHub Actions run on a clean runner

risks.title: Texture model misses digitally simulated prints / recaptures
risks.detail: AS-15 (expected failure): the MiniFAS model, trained on physical attacks, passed simulated halftone prints and low-resolution recaptures as real. Mitigation: kiosk check-ins also need the random head-movement challenge, which planar media cannot perform (LV-04, LV-05, LV-13). CCTV sightings need natural movement too, or go to review.

risks.title: 3D silicone masks, live deepfakes via virtual camera, and kiosk-account frame injection
risks.detail: Not addressed by RGB liveness. Mitigations: supervised kiosks, kiosk accounts only on managed devices, IR/depth cameras and an ISO/IEC 30107-3 certified PAD SDK for high-stakes use.

risks.title: Camera IDs can be enumerated by the media server
risks.detail: MediaMTX answers 404 for unknown paths and 401 for existing ones before authorisation. Reveals only which camera numbers exist; the service is bound to localhost/VPN.

risks.title: View-only cannot stop filming the screen
risks.detail: Unblurred results are watermarked with the request number and viewer, expire after 15 minutes, and every view is alerted.

risks.title: Vault key in Python memory during a render
risks.detail: CPython cannot guarantee memory wiping; run the API on a trusted, patched host.

risks.title: Logout signs the user out on all devices
risks.detail: Trade-off of the D-13 fix (server-side revocation via session version).

risks.title: Setup code readable by anyone with shell access to the server
risks.detail: Until the first super admin registers, the setup code is in a 0600 file on the server. Anyone with that access already controls the host. Complete setup immediately after installation.

test_bugs.issue: Wrong base32 padding in the test itself.
First backlight case used a well-lit face on a white wall ('real' was correct).
test_bugs.fix: Synthetic dark face against a bright background.

test_bugs.issue: Cross-camera check used an unconfigured path (404 before auth).
Selector matched the hidden login form's MFA field.
test_bugs.fix: Scope selectors to the step-up dialog.

test_bugs.issue: Role switched without reloading the single-page app.

test_bugs.fix: Deterministic check: ciphertext does not parse.

test_bugs.issue: Fake video bytes could not be exported (transcode).
test_bugs.fix: Generate a real encrypted segment with ffmpeg.

test_bugs.issue: Clicked the first button in the form, which was the show-password toggle, so the form never submitted.
test_bugs.fix: Submit buttons are explicitly type=submit; the test targets them.

test_bugs.issue: The test super admin's password contained its username, so the new password policy correctly refused it and 60 dependent tests could not start.
test_bugs.fix: Fixture password no longer contains the username.
